title: Amazon buildings using warehouse robots

source.name: Amazon Robotics deployment footprint, as reported alongside the 2025 one-millionth-robot/DeepFleet announcement

notes: Robots were piloted in a single facility after the 2012 Kiva Systems acquisition. By the 2025 one-millionth-robot milestone, Amazon said its robots operated across more than 300 fulfillment and sortation buildings.
